newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end mixed, June S&P lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end mixed, June S&P lower.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures ended a choppy session mixed as June Standard and Poor's 500 futures registered minor losses.
June S&Ps posted an inside day on daily bar charts, a technical formation that traders said shows the market was pausing after two days of record highs.

Traders said S&P 500 action appeared "toppy" and said the market lacked follow-through on both rallies and downdrafts Wednesday. June S&Ps opened weak, turned higher before midday, but failed to challenge 854.00 resistance and the 854.70 all-time high set Tuesday.
June set the session low of 844.60 after Treasury bond futures closed, but support at 843.00 and Tuesday's low of 842.60 held.
S&P 500 futures players had been closely watching T-bonds all session and locals were quick to sell when June T-bonds cut gains and closed below 108-30/32, traders said.
But in the last half hour of trade, June S&Ps cut losses slightly to end near the middle of the day's range.
"It did seem like people were taking a break," one S&P 500 futures source said. "It was mostly local trade all day, but it picked up a little into the close," he said.
On Thursday, the latest weekly jobless claims, New York purchasing managers data and the April help-wanted index will be released.

Traders said stock indices gleaned little direction from Wednesday's economic events. Treasury auctioned $16.5 billion in two-year notes at 6.328 percent. The bid-to-cover ratio was 2.43 and non-competitive bids totalled $1.41 billion.
Before stocks opened, U.S. April durable goods were reported up 1.4 percent overall and up 0.6 percent excluding defense.

At the close, June S&P 500s were down 0.80 point at 850.55, Nasdaq 100 fell 1.75 to 985.00, NYSE Composites were down 0.20 at 441.30, KCBT Value Lines rose 2.00 to 753.40, Nikkeis were up 450 at 20,345, Midcap 400s were up 1.00 at 277.80, and Russell 2000s were up 2.55 at 379.90.
